startersHint: A starter sets how the pages look and which messages are kept. Add a chat below and you will see the result straight away. You can change more under More options.
addHint: Use WhatsApp's Export chat to make a text file or a zip, then pick it here. It is read on your device and is never uploaded.
helpTitle: How do I export a chat?
helpAndroid: Android: open the chat, tap the three dots, then More, then Export chat. Choose Without media for a small text file, or Include media if you want photos in the PDF. Share it to Files, Drive or email, then pick it here.
helpIphone: iPhone: open the chat, tap the name at the top, then Export Chat. Choose Without Media or Attach Media, and save it to Files. Pick the saved file here.
helpZip: If you get a zip file, pick the zip itself. The tool finds the chat inside it and shows the photos too.
readFailed: This file could not be read as a WhatsApp chat. Pick the text file (or the zip) made by WhatsApp's Export chat.
noMessages: No messages were found in this file. Check that it is the text file made by Export chat, and try the date order choice if dates look wrong.
zipNoChat: This zip has no chat text file inside it.
dateOrderHint: The dates in this file could be read either way, so check the dates on the pages. Day first is used until you change it.
dateHint: Leave both empty to keep the whole chat.
me: Show whose messages on the right
meHint: Chat bubbles put your own messages on the right, like WhatsApp does. Pick yourself.
previewEmpty: Add a chat or try the sample chat to see the pages here.
noMatch: No messages match these choices. Change the dates, people or search.
photosShown: {n} photos are shown on the pages.
tooLong: This would be more than {max} pages. Choose a shorter date range, or turn off some message types, to make it smaller.
times: Show the time of each message
summaryHint: The first page shows how many messages each person sent, how many days, and the busiest day.
photosHint: Only works when you pick a zip made with Include media. Up to {max} photos are shown.
pageNumbers: Page numbers and title at the bottom
hideNumbersHint: Replaces phone numbers in names and messages with dots and the last three digits, so the printout is safer to share.
systemHint: Lines such as Messages are end-to-end encrypted, or someone joined.
media: Show notes for photos and files
mediaHint: Photos and files are not part of a text export, so a short note is shown in their place.
keepOpen: Keep this page open until it is done. A long chat can take a minute.
failed: The PDF could not be made. Try a shorter date range or the Smaller file quality.
notSelectable: The pages are saved as pictures so Hindi, other scripts and emoji look right. That means the text in the PDF cannot be selected or searched.
notSaved: Your chat is never saved or uploaded. Only your look and message choices are remembered on this device.

labels.media: Photo or file (not in the text export)
